notes.title: Major Update – BOT.vinnik Gets Even Sharper!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings fellow chess enthusiasts,[/p][p][/p][p]Check out what's new:[/p][p]🔊 [b]New BOT.vinnik Reactions:[/b] We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.[/p][p]✏️ [b]Comprehensive Text Revision:[/b] Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.[/p][p]🖥️ [b]Windowed Mode:[/b] You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing [b]ALT + ENTER[/b].[/p][p]🛠️ [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.[/p][p]📈 [b]Gameplay Flow Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.[/p][/*][*][p]Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]Minor Visual Refinements:[/b] Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.[/p][p]🚀 [b]New Splash Screen:[/b] Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games![/p][p][/p][p]And there’s more coming soon: in just [b]one week[/b], we’ll be releasing the demo of our newest title, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][b]BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy[/b][/url]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks for all the support, and see you on the chessboard![/p][p]— The Deep Green Games Team[/p]
